original.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane validates Compositions with CEL, and its core code now returns an error saying the --enable-composition-webhook-schema-validation flag will be removed in a future release.

decision.reason: The change text shows v2.0.0 adds an error return in cmd/crossplane/core/core.go [ev-59d22c21eec4]. The error names only --enable-composition-webhook-schema-validation and says it will be removed in a future release. So only an environment that passes this flag can be exposed, which is the standard condition for a deprecated or removed flag: cli-flag set. Neither excerpt shows the code around the new line ([ev-2875a348b5d7], [ev-59d22c21eec4] contain only '/*'), so the exact trigger (for example whether an explicit false also triggers it) is unconfirmed, hence low confidence.
